name: Recommendation card with AI answer
summary: A result card (eyebrow, badge, avatar initials, name, meta, gains, primary and secondary buttons) that opens with a circular reveal from a point, rows cascade in, an AI answer streams word by word with tags, then a tap presses the primary button, which wipes to a confirmed state with sparks.

params.card: { eyebrow, badge, avatar, name, meta, gains[], primary, done, secondary }
params.ai: { who, text, tags: [{ text, tone: 'accent'|'good'|'bad'|'warn' }] } or null
params.origin: { x, y, r } screen point for the reveal, or (frame) => point; defaults to frame.pick
params.cues: { reveal, answer, tags, press, out (the card pulls into the camera just before out) }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as answer from '../blocks/answer-card/index.mjs';
const pick = answer.create(ctx, { card: copy.pick, ai: copy.answer, cues: { reveal: CUE.answer, answer: CUE.answerText, tags: CUE.tags, press: CUE.add, out: CUE.drop } });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the DraftKit showreel answer scene

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
